name: Dinner Date
source:
What was supposed to be a simple dinner date becomes a complete disaster when two roommates are forced to hide a half-eaten corpse from an unsuspecting and very attractive guest.

As the night spirals further out of control, every decision matters. Can you keep the truth buried long enough to survive the evening?

[From [url=https://ps-studio.itch.io/dinner-date]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
原本只是一场简简单单的晚餐约会，却在两名室友被迫向一位毫不知情又魅力十足的客人藏匿半具被啃食过的尸体时，彻底演变成了一场惊天灾难。

随着这一夜愈发失控，每一个决定都至关重要。你能否将真相死死掩埋，平安熬过今晚？

[摘自[url=https://ps-studio.itch.io/dinner-date]itch.io[/url]]
